title: RentEvent
description: An append-only, signed event on a RentObligation. Events are never edited or deleted; corrections are new CorrectionIssued events referencing the corrected event. Obligation state and renter reliability are derived exclusively from event history. Events contain protocol identifiers and amounts only — never PII. The canonical byte serialization for signing and Merkle inclusion is JCS (RFC 8785) of this object with `signature` removed.

obligation_id.description: The obligation this event belongs to.

sequence.description: Monotonic position of this event within its obligation's stream. Gaps are invalid; duplicates are conflicts to be resolved by the store, never silently merged.

event_type.description: See docs/protocol.md for the legal state-transition table. ObligationSatisfied may only be emitted when settled funding sources sum to amount_due (net of accepted concessions).

occurred_at.description: When the real-world fact happened (RFC 3339, UTC).

recorded_at.description: When the event was appended to the ledger. recorded_at >= occurred_at; both are kept because late-arriving evidence is normal.

issuer.description: Identifier of the party attesting this event (DID or key identifier, e.g. did:key:..., did:web:...). Reliability derivation weights events by issuer trust class.

correlation_id.description: Optional. Groups events belonging to one resolution flow (e.g. a modification request and its acceptance).

corrects_event_id.description: Required when event_type is CorrectionIssued: the event being corrected. The corrected event remains in history; derivation applies the correction.

payload.description: Type-specific facts. Money amounts are integers in minor units and use the obligation's currency. Free-text fields are forbidden in v0.1 — narrative context belongs in the private data plane, referenced by opaque document IDs.

amount.description: Amount this event concerns, in minor units (e.g. the settled portion for PaymentSettled, the committed grant for AssistanceCommitted).

funding_source_type.description: Where the money in this event comes from. Drives the independently-funded vs assisted reliability distinction.

provider_id.description: Provider responsible for this commitment/settlement, when applicable.

new_due_at.description: For accepted modifications: the approved new due date for the deferred portion.

policy_decision_id.description: Reference to the deterministic policy-engine decision that authorized a modification. Agents never approve; policies do.

reference.description: Opaque external reference (processor ID, document ID). Must not be guessable PII.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable code (e.g. ACH return code R01, dispute category). Never free text.

signature.description: Detached signature by the issuer over the JCS canonical form of this event with `signature` removed.

key_id.description: Identifier of the issuer key used (kid / DID verification method).
